Published original-parent-to-captured coverage on formalize at 141cd366b92eaf957536b0873e5b6f9ec7b7025b (four commits). SourcePruningEnumerationCapturedEdge.selected_parent_complete starts from the original satisfying model of a ready stored ordinary parent, original native/resource admission, and a selector permutation of its resident rows. It derives an accepted offered edge, actual successful guard projection and inherited arity, then constructs that same captured call's completed fragment and final satisfying cache. The extension fixes every original variable, including the captured slot. The full resource/history packet, actual caller, full Memos and uniform inner observer remain. The chosen model precedes outer edge/work bounds. No supplied accepted edge, projection, arity, future success or final assignment is needed.

Three modules, 536 lines and five public theorems. Strict installed checks and standalone Audit pass; Audit 4245 jobs / 80074 theorem dependencies. Public readback has 173 full blocks, 667078 bytes, SHA256 4453ff071f4251bd7b753e880e0301ccdc5c1eed804c34a416d7fece799ee2a5; all 168 prior blocks are the exact 630571-byte prefix. Prior 90 strong modules, 437 enumeration sources and 203 Haskell pins remain unchanged. Three sealed reviews and portable/committed evidence pass: lean/restart-evidence/20261027-selector-capture, 532 payloads, manifest b0ea0826ef745b186ed2525fa36e920ba9041c967516bcc405ca16431e6d6b5b.

Next: prove actual ordered scan reachability at a selected index from original prefix support. Earlier arity-allowed project=None can stop NativeBranches, and earlier hooks can stop NativeContinuations. Preserve reached caller/full Memos and fixed captured-cache restoration. Raw interned selection retains acceptance directly; modeled canonical selection still needs explicit map-or-fallback row permutation. Physical canonical storage/sorting, recursive expansion/frontier policy, discharged rendering coverage, API admission and Haskell correspondence remain open. H6 and checked finite rendering soundness keep prior scopes. FINDINGS and restart docs are current, including lean/notes-current-selector-capture.md. Main 8766699b594eaad80381af2eee034c378ccf3192 remains integrated with LPO/extraction documentation fixes. No Haskell/Cabal change, native test or benchmark ran; no new physical Haskell defect is claimed. Existing KBO candidate/context-reversal handoffs remain open. Whole goal ACTIVE.
